title: Scale AI
summary: Data-labelling and evaluation company that supplies much of the human feedback behind frontier models.
bodyHtml:
Scale AI manages labelled data, model evaluation and reinforcement-learning environments for AI labs, enterprises and government customers.

As model training shifts toward post-training and agentic evaluation, the demand for curated task environments has grown rather than shrunk, making data operations a strategic layer rather than a commodity.

Why it matters

  • Data Engine for labelling and annotation
  • Evaluation and red-teaming
  • Defence and government work

businessMeaning: The business question for any AI lab is whether data operations are core or outsourceable. Scale's position depends on staying ahead of synthetic data.
investmentLens: Private; a picks-and-shovels bet on AI training budgets rather than on any single model.
